proposals.title: ITEM 4—SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ADDITIONAL BOARD COMMITTEE TO OVERSEE PUBLIC POLICY

proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an additional Board committee to oversee public policy.
